description.zh-CN: 文件读写与检索：读 / 列目录 / 搜索 / 写（带备份可撤销）/ 删除
description.en-US: File ops: read / list / grep / write (undoable via backup) / delete

tools.name: fs.read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file. Args: path (string, absolute), max_bytes (number, default 32768, max 1048576). Output is truncated at max_bytes; the response flags `truncated`.

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)

tools.name: fs.list
tools.description: List a directory (dirs first, then files, with type and size). Args: path (string, absolute).

path.description: absolute directory path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)

tools.name: fs.grep
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring search over text files in a directory tree. Args: path (absolute), query (string), max_results (default 50, max 200), max_depth (default 3, max 8).

path.description: absolute directory path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)

tools.name: fs.write
tools.description: Write a UTF-8 text file (create or overwrite). Args: path (absolute), content, create_dirs (bool, default false). The previous content, if any, is backed up automatically and the result carries {path, bytes, existed, backup}; pass that result to fs.restore to undo.

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)

tools.name: fs.delete
tools.description: Delete a file (directories are rejected in v1). Args: path (absolute). Irreversible — no backup is kept, the call requires user approval.

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)

tools.name: fs.restore
tools.description: Undo a previous fs.write by restoring its backup (the backup is consumed; restoring twice is a no-op). Usually invoked by the compensation layer, not by the model. Args mirror the compensation payload {call_id, args, output}; only output.{path, backup, existed} is used. Irreversible — restoring overwrites the file's current content, so the call requires user approval.

call_id.description: id of the original fs.write call
